question: Does saved-stage/late-window/seed heterogeneity undermine the narrow positive auxiliary-alignment observation, and is observed geometry dominated by a selected chain?
prior_exposure: TDIAG1 had positive summed auxiliary/main cosine in two early windows of one parent and a class-balanced sample. This is a motivated extension on already exposed data, not confirmation or evidence of improvement.

checkpoints.interpretation: Parent epoch3 and actual saved one-epoch head child; not two-epoch V1 and not a continuous saved optimizer trajectory. Same head-FT gcorr/auxiliary objective is examined at both stages, even though parent training used wmse.

sample.source: datasets/valid.parquet with pure chains and fold != model held-out fold; these are head-FT training rows
sample.count: 16 distinct chains per model fold, same observations for both seeds and both stages
sample.chain_rule: SHA256(TDIAG2:chain_id) ascending among eligible chains; no class stratification
sample.sequence_rule: One eligible row group per selected chain, smallest SHA256(TDIAG2:row:row_group). Thus natural chain sampling, not size-biased sequence/row sampling; only one representative sequence of each chain is observed.
sample.overlap: Model folds may share training chains; record overlap and never treat four parent/fold pairs as independent seeds.
sample.causal_prefix: Replay the full 20000-row input sequence from its actual reset, then select the three fixed windows. Full targets construct legitimate structure/next-change training labels; targets never feed trunk. Warmup is first99 rows.

identity: Before forward: checkpoint/plan/code/split/class hashes; selected full feature/target/mask byte hashes; source Parquet stat before/after. Assert every non-head parent/child state tensor exactly equal before reusing recurrent features; mismatch stops without replacement.
calculation: CPU float32 dropout0 eval, mathematically equivalent model-mode forward to this deterministic head-FT recipe, not AMP reproduction. Trunk inference in microbatches4, detached concat(GRU,projection) across16. Each window pools16 sequences exactly as training batch. Main un-clipped-p gcorr, structure .3 CE, next .3 MSE+BCE use source masks and normalizations. Compute separate component head gradients, shared/private norms and clipping factors. No optimizer or model update.
sensitivity: For each fixed stage/window, recompute all losses/gradients after masking out each of the16 selected chains in turn, including re-centering/re-normalization. Record exact leave-one-chain-out cosine/clip factor and removed weight share. This is descriptive finite-sample sensitivity, not a batch bootstrap, seed CI, or independent replication.
readouts: all 24 stage/window summaries with four parents separately
paired saved-head1 minus parent summaries at identical observations
every component cosine; shared, main-private, aux-private norms
chain/class metric mass, auxiliary mask counts, chain mass concentration
nonclaims: common clipping rescale implies proportional update
chain observations or windows are training seed replications
natural-chain sample reproduces natural scored-row distribution
execution: Root schedules only after code/plan freeze and review. Exception/timeout writes partial immutable result and stops; no resampling, alternate checkpoint or silent retry.
